tools.label: Soft surface to work on (rug or blanket)

steps.title: Glides into the boards
steps.text: Lay the lower headboard and the footboard on a rug and tap three glides into the bottom edge of each.
tools: Soft surface to work on (rug or blanket)

steps.title: Cam bolts into the boards
steps.text: Screw four cam bolts into the lower headboard: into the top and the bottom hole of the three at each end.
steps.warning: Stop turning when the collar of the bolt touches the board.

steps.title: Cam bolts into the boards
steps.text: Screw four cam bolts into the inner face of the footboard the same way.

steps.title: Stand up the frame parts
steps.text: Stand the two boards up, facing each other.

steps.title: Stand up the frame parts
steps.text: Stand the side rails between them, with a gap at each end of the rails.

steps.title: Dowels into the side rails
steps.text: Push three short dowels into the end of the side rail: two into the top, one into the middle hole.
steps.warning: Use the 12 short dowels here, not the 5 long ones.

steps.title: Dowels into the side rails
steps.text: Do the same at the other three rail ends.

steps.title: Dowels into the side rails
steps.text: Do the same at the other three rail ends.

steps.title: Dowels into the side rails
steps.text: Do the same at the other three rail ends.

steps.title: Cam locks into the side rails
steps.text: Push the eight cam locks into the round holes at the ends of the side rails.
steps.note: The arrow on each lock must point to the end of the rail.

steps.title: Join the frame
steps.text: Push the side rails, the headboard and the footboard together.

steps.title: Tighten the cam locks
steps.text: Turn each cam lock clockwise with the Allen key until it is tight.

steps.title: Long dowels into the headboard
steps.text: Push the five long dowels into the top edge of the lower headboard.

steps.title: Bolts into the upper panel
steps.text: Lay the upper headboard panel on a table and screw the four hanger bolts into its bottom edge with the wrench.
steps.warning: Stop turning when the collar of the bolt reaches the edge.

steps.title: Put on the upper panel
steps.text: Lower the upper panel onto the dowels. From the inside, push a plastic clip over each bolt and tighten a nut with the wrench.

steps.title: Screw on the slat rails
steps.text: Screw a steel slat rail to the inside of each side rail with eight screws.
steps.note: The rails can go higher or lower, to suit the thickness of your mattress.
steps.warning: Use the long wood screws here, not the short machine screws.

steps.title: Middle beam brackets
steps.text: Screw a middle beam bracket to the middle of the headboard with two screws.
steps.note: Use the holes that match the height you chose for the slat rails.
steps.warning: Use the long wood screws here, not the short machine screws.

steps.title: Middle beam brackets
steps.text: Screw the second bracket to the middle of the footboard the same way.

steps.title: Diagonal braces
steps.text: Pull each diagonal brace out to length and screw it on under the bracket and under the slat rail.
steps.note: The braces slide out to the length you need.

steps.title: Square the frame
steps.text: Check that the frame is square, then fix each brace with one more screw through its slot.
steps.note: The sides must be straight, not bowed in or out.

steps.title: Put in the middle beam
steps.text: Lower the middle beam, still pushed together, with its head end into the bracket at the headboard.
steps.warning: Do not hold your hand under the end of the beam: the edge is sharp.

steps.title: Put in the middle beam
steps.text: Pull the inner section out by its end hook and lower it into the bracket at the footboard.
steps.note: Press down on the beam with your other hand while you pull.

steps.title: Slat holders
steps.text: Screw four slat holders onto the slat rails and the middle beam at the head end.
steps.note: Only needed for the roll-out LURÖY slats, not for a slatted base with a frame.

steps.title: Slat holders
steps.text: Screw the other four slat holders on at the foot end the same way.

steps.title: Lay in the slatted bases
steps.text: Roll out the two slatted bases, then push the end slats inwards under the slat holders.
